errors.text_span: диапазонът на която е от 1 до 3
errors.evidence: The description states that the range for the y-axis of chart B is from 1 to 3. However, the chart shows data points below 1 (around 0.4) and above 3 (around 3.4), so the actual data range is wider than described.

errors.text_span: постепенно се повишава до върхове около 52 в 2012–2013 г.
errors.evidence: The description generalizes that there were peaks around 52 in 2012-2013. In fact, there is a clear single peak value of approximately 52 in 2013, while the value in 2012 is lower, at approximately 50.

errors.text_span: Тя започва при стойност около 1.2 в 2008 г.
errors.evidence: The description states the starting value for chart B in 2008 is around 1.2. The data point is clearly shown at 1.5 on the y-axis.
The description incorrectly states that the value in 2012-2013 decreases to around 1.0. The actual values are much lower, at approximately 0.5 in 2012 and 0.4 in 2013.

errors.text_span: продължава да спада до най-ниска стойност около 0.9 през 2017 г.
errors.evidence: This part of the description is entirely incorrect. The line does not continue to fall after 2013; it rises. The lowest point is in 2013 (approx. 0.4), not 2017. The value in 2017 is approximately 1.1, not 0.9.
